pricing.dex: Actual two-hop V3 TWAP and spot ticks with runtime, history, freshness, locked-pool and liquidity checks
pricing.reference: Test-controlled price derived from post-shock DEX spot; NOT an independent production feed
pricing.normal: Require normal per-hop spot/TWAP deviation and reference agreement; return the lower average/reference price
pricing.downwardGap: Require both spot and reference below average and spot/reference agreement; return reference price, never the lower manipulated spot

limitations: Conditional liveness improvement only: five seconds is chosen simulated reference latency, not a measured production SLA
No independent PONS feed has been established; CASHCAT/USDG Pyth access, identity and independence remain unverified
The wrapper and engine depend on the same authenticated reference in fast mode; they are not two independent off-chain feeds
The original strict TWAP path is unchanged and remains blocked during large spot deviations
Inactive pool observation blockage remains; this policy does not bypass freshness or missing history
One pinned block, one borrower, approximately 95 USDG loans and a single shock per tested exit
No proof for sequencer outages, sustained/correlated manipulation, MEV, adverse keeper latency or multiple simultaneous liquidations
Sale proceeds include swap fees but exclude native gas and full L2 fees; no keeper profitability guarantee
Runtime hash checks do not establish upstream publisher independence, identity or proxy upgrade safety
No production parameters, deployment, audit or market admission approved by these tests
